## Type

- [ ] feature (`feature/*` into `develop`)
- [ ] bugfix (`bugfix/*` into `develop`)
- [ ] release (`release/*` into `main`)
- [ ] hotfix (`hotfix/*` into `main`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally
- [ ] Works in both LTR and RTL
- [ ] Keyboard accessible, visible focus
- [ ] No network calls added (or documented in `docs/02-architecture.md`)
- [ ] User-supplied HTML, files and fonts are validated or sanitised
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased**
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed
